clips.why: Comedy plus verdict. Hook: 'Assassin's Creed Shadows. All right, put the pitchforks down, I'm just the messenger, chill chill chill... everybody needs to relax.' Then: would I spend $28 on it? No. Is it as bad as people say? The discourse was a crap show, but 'the characters are absolute garbage, the story is absolute trash, the open world is gorgeous' (312.7). The 'if you're into content completion you'll have a good time' line (318.7) is an acceptable close; the later 'Ivar trash, Naoye trash' riff would push it past 75s and repeats the characters point.

Take: Black Flag Resynced is 'a whopping ten percent off' at $54, but Black Flag is the best Assassin's Creed ever; after Shadows' and Valhalla's garbage characters, 'when you have charisma machines like Edward Kenway, bro, how did Assassin's Creed fall off from a character standpoint this hard?' Opening on the sarcastic deal line or on 'AC Black Flag is one of the greatest AC games' (375.8) both work. Lands on the fall-off line / 'it is so crazy to me'.

Hot take: Expedition 33 was his co-GOTY, but 'I hate that the game got so big' the discourse devolved into 'you aren't real RPG fans, it's overrated'; 'I've been playing JRPGs since most of you weren't into video games -- all right, some of you are older than me'. Payoff: Metaphor and Expedition 33 can both be great games and coexist. Opens on 'Expedition 33 is a phenomenal game' (the game must be named; 'everybody knows how I feel about Expedition 33' at 180.2 also works). The reveal-date aside (189-198) is dead weight that can't be cut.

Take: 'I will give a shout to Dragon Ball Sparking Zero' -- people were disappointed, but as a Tenkaichi kid he never wanted a balanced competitive fighter; 'Yajirobe being insanely powerful was one of the funniest things ever, and then they ultimately patched it.' Lands on the Yajirobe line; 'I'm not looking for something incredibly well balanced out of a game like this' (729.0) is an acceptable restating close.

negatives.why: Intro: deals for 'ballers pulling up with the Lambo' bit and 'be selective spending over $20' advice; funny framing but it's the show's opener with no payoff.
Kingdom Hearts collection deal read off the store page ('all of that for thirty dollars... well, guess what'); lively but it's the deal and its contents list.
Star Ocean Second Story R price gripe ('why is it still $25?') plus a quick recommendation; a deal read.
Trails in the Sky 2nd chapter launch discount; 'highest-rated game of 2026, warms this dark heart' sounds like a closer but it's a deal shout-out.
Red Dead Redemption $25 for a 16-year-old game; deal commentary that trails off into playtime estimates.
Split Fiction deal: 'you'll need the rare commodity known as a friend' one-liner, then Hazelight praise and Friend's Pass details read as a pitch.
